summary: PDF Solutions filed an 8-K regarding a First Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank. The amendment increases the revolving credit facility to $75 million and introduces leverage-based adjustments to commitment fees based on total debt-to-EBITDA ratios. All other material terms remain unchanged. This is a routine refinancing/credit facility modification, not a special situation event. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic restructuring is involved.
